betterarmorstands.missing_mycel: Mycel is missing. %s needs the Mycel library to work and stays off until it is installed.
betterarmorstands.config.sneakPoses.desc: Sneak + right-click an armor stand with an empty hand to switch to the next pose.
betterarmorstands.config.redstonePoses.d: A redstone signal next to an armor stand picks a pose by its strength (1 to 12, 13 and up wrap around).
betterarmorstands.config.armsByDefault.d: New armor stands have arms, like in Bedrock Edition.
betterarmorstands.config.shearsBasePlate: Right-click an armor stand with shears to remove or bring back its base plate.
betterarmorstands.config.allowTurning.de: Players with the mod may hold R and move the mouse to turn an armor stand.
